title: Gizemli Hikaye Küpleri: Vahşi Orman
author: Fatih Cem Gülbent
description: When Deniz uses the special cubes in his hand, a whole new adventure begins in his room, and an ordinary day turns into an unforgettable journey. Join in on the excitement, battle weasels in the wild forest, befriend Zıp Zıp the monkey, and try to find your way through the fog. Remember, every choice will lead you to a different adventure!
